change: PhysicalReductionContinuation exposes optional mergeCheckpoint capability, preserving compatibility for other backend implementations. CPU continuations implement it with shared restore/merge dispatch for grouped and ungrouped owned accumulators. Failure closes the continuation because a prefix may have committed; source remains borrowed and unchanged.

edgeCases: append before and after merging grouped/ungrouped checkpoints
source checkpoint remains unchanged and may be released after merge
oversized checkpoint admission fails and releases target state
wrong checkpoint kind fails and closes target

remaining: Parquet aggregate tasks still use legacy unowned accumulator functions; this generic capability is the integration prerequisite.
Shared pool ownership for aggregate task partials and asynchronous transport remains required.
